title: WAPP: Safe Learning of Positive Security WAF Policies from Live Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2609.06840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web Application Firewalls (WAFs) mainly rely on signatures to detect known attacks, which can leave gaps against modified or previously unseen payloads. Positive security provides a complementary approach by learning legitimate traffic and blocking inputs that fall outside the learned profile. However, learning directly from live traffic can be unsafe when malicious requests contaminate the training data. This paper presents the Whitelisting Autonomous Policy Producer (WAPP), a framework that combines trust filtering, deterministic rule synthesis, confidence scoring, and validation before enforcement. WAPP is evaluated on three controlled applications using a live Coraza and OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS) stack. Results show that, on the tested DVWA username field, unfiltered learning becomes Degraded at 0.2\% poisoned traffic and Broken at 0.5%, while the evaluated free text field can admit malicious inputs even without poisoning. translated_title: WAPP：从真实流量中安全学习正向安全WAF策略
translated_abstract: Web应用防火墙（WAF）主要依靠签名来检测已知攻击，这在面对经过修改或此前未见过的攻击载荷时可能存在防护缺口。正向安全提供了一种互补方法，通过学习合法流量并拦截超出所学正常画像范围的输入来实现防护。然而，当恶意请求污染训练数据时，直接从真实流量中学习可能是不安全的。本文提出了白名单自治策略生成器，这是一个融合了信任过滤、确定性规则合成、置信度评分以及策略实施前验证的框架。WAPP在一个采用Coraza与OWASP核心规则集（CRS）的实时技术栈上，针对三个受控应用进行了评估。结果显示，在测试的DVWA用户名字段上，未经过滤的学习在0.2%的投毒流量下会出现性能降级，在0.5%时则完全失效；而所评估的自由文本字段即使在没有投毒的情况下也可能放行恶意输入。
tldr: 提出了WAPP框架，通过融合信任过滤、确定性规则合成、置信度评分和实施前验证，实现了在恶意请求可能污染训练数据的情况下，从真实流量中安全地自动学习正向（白名单）WAF安全策略。
en_tdlr: WAPP is a framework that safely learns positive (whitelisting) WAF policies from live traffic by combining trust filtering, deterministic rule synthesis, confidence scoring, and validation before enforcement, even when training data may be poisoned by malicious requests.
